source: @mrgnlabs/marginfi-client-v2@6.4.2 production config (configs.json) + official marginfi bank-metadata cache + offline PDA derivation (@solana/web3.js)
groupSource: marginfi-client-v2 configs.json, environment=production (cluster=mainnet). Not a hand-typed constant.

usdcBankSelection.rule: Bank in the production group whose on-chain Bank.mint == underlyingMint. The official marginfi bank-metadata cache contains exactly one tokenSymbol=USDC entry whose tokenAddress equals the USDC mint, giving a single candidate. The derive script MUST re-verify on-chain: Bank.group == group AND Bank.mint == underlyingMint, and fail loudly if more than one production USDC bank is found.

vaultDerivation: PDA(["liquidity_vault", bank], program) and PDA(["liquidity_vault_auth", bank], program). Seeds confirmed in marginfi-client-v2 constants.ts (PDA_BANK_LIQUIDITY_VAULT_SEED / PDA_BANK_LIQUIDITY_VAULT_AUTH_SEED).
adapterDerivation: adapter_id = sha256("solana-yield-adapter:marginfi-usdc"); state PDA = PDA(["adapter", adapter_id], BCvRj9JakpU1mpo67yt7WjknSAcTqAJMWCSyurcRhBb1); adapterUnderlyingVault = ATA(state, USDC) under the associated-token program.

oracle.note: Bank.config.oracle_keys[0] / oracle_setup / oracle_max_age. Requires an on-chain read of the USDC bank account; resolve with scripts/derive-marginfi-accounts.ts on a machine with RPC. Used only for lending_account_withdraw health checks.

disclaimer: Account map only. MarginFi CPI is NOT implemented and no mainnet-fork roundtrip has been run.
